profiles.name: SHIELD OF FAITH
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit, or one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit within 3" of it.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds. If you targeted an ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army with this Stratagem, then until the end of the phase, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is unit is within 3" of your unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LIGHT OF THE EMPEROR
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is blessed. While a unit is blessed, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the profile characteristics of its models; the Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws). If your unit has the JUMP PACK keyword, until the end of the turn, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 3" of your unit, that friendly unit is also blessed.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FAITH AND FURY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of your unit's attacks this phase, you gain 1 Miracle dice.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLINDING RADIANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, or one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit within 3" of such a unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If you targeted an ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army with this Stratagem, then until the end of the phase, while a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is unit is within 3" of your unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DIVINE GUIDANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of any of those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ANGELIC DESCENT
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHIELD OF AVERSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RIGHTEOUS BLOWS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of attacks made by those weapons this phase, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CARRY FORTH THE FAITHFUL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just before an ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT model from your army Advances.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your TRANSPORT, and units can disembark from your TRANSPORT even though it Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move, and cannot declare a charge this turn
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CLEANSING FLAMES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RITES OF FIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 6" that is also within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLAZING IRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, and can then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHIELD OF DENIAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability against mortal wounds. If your unit is Righteous, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUFFER NOT THE UNFAITHFUL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that is Righteous and that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TO THE HEART OF HERESY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. If your unit is Righteous, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PATH OF THE RIGHTEOUS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, if your unit is Righteous, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BASTION OF FAITH
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Celestian Sacresants unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. In addition, if your unit is Righteous, you can select one other CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit from your army that is not Battle-shocked and is within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INDEFATIGABLE DEDICATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is Righteous, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DIVINE INTERVENTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adepta Sororitas Character unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: You can discard 1-3 Miracle dice. At the end of the phase, set the last destroyed model from your unit back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy models. Roll one D3, adding 1 to the result for each Miracle dice you discarded. That model is set back up with that number of wounds remaining (up to its starting number of wounds). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select Saint Celestine as the target of this Stratagem. You cannot select the same CHARACTER as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUFFERING AND SACRIFICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adepta Sororitas Infantry or Adepta Sororitas Walker unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects its targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RIGHTEOUS VENGEANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and, if your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SANCTIFIED IMMOLATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though It was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPIRIT OF THE MARTYR
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRAISE THE FALLEN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FINAL REDEMPTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One PENITENT unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PURITY OF SUFFERING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One PENITENT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, PENITENT models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PASSION OF THE PENITENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One PENITENT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a PENITENT model in your unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LASH OF GUILT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just before a PENITENT unit from your army Advances.
profiles.target_descriptor: That PENITENT unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the PENITENT ENGINES keyword, do not make an Advance roll for it; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BOUNDLESS ZEAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTA SORORITAS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the PENITENT keyword, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEVOUT FANATICISM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One PENITENT unit from your army that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but it must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SLAYER OF CHAMPIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes Character unit from your army that has just destroyed the unit you selected at the start of your Command phase as the target of your Assemblage of Might ability.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit on the battlefield Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army makes an attack that target that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll In addition, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, gain 1CP.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUPERHUMAN RESERVES
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an Adeptus Custodes Warlord model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet or from an Enhancement that says it can only be used Once per battle.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Adeptus Custodes Warlord model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your model can use its Once per battle' ability one additional time during this battle (but not in the same phase). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE EMPEROR'S AUSPICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, CHARACTER models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EARNING OF A NAME
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Adeptus Custodes Character units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a CHARACTER model in either of your units makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VIGIL UNENDING
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes Character model from your army that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Do not remove your destroyed model from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHOULDER THE MANTLE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes Character model from your army that is not leading a unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one friendly unit (excluding Battle-shocked and Attached units) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it could lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your model attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit's Starting Strength accordingly.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GILDED CHAMPION
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an Adeptus Custodes Character model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used 'once per battle'.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your model can use that 'once per battle' ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEFIANT TO THE LAST
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if that model has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PEERLESS WARRIOR
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Allarus Custodians or Aquilon Custodians unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DESPERATION'S PRICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Anathema Psykana unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WITCH HUNTERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Anathema Psykana unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Vigilators unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Prosecutors unit from your army that has just shot.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an Anathema Psykana model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PURGATION SWEEP
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Witchseekers unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PSYCHIC ABOMINATIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Anathema Psykana Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARCANE GENETIC ALCHEMY
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an Adeptus Custodes model from your army(excluding Anathema Psykana models).
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES model's unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that is below its Starting Strength.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNWAVERING SENTINELS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MULTIPOTENTIALITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VIGILANCE ETERNAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes Battleline unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARCHEOTECH MUNITIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FLAWLESS CONSTRUCTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EMPEROR'S VENGEANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the Walker keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WRATHFUL ADVANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNSTOPPABLE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Custodes Vehicle or Adeptus Custodes Mounted unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RELENTLESS PERSECUTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Adeptus Custodes Vehicle unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the Walker keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PUNISHMENT INESCAPABLE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HUNT AS ONE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your units are eilgible to shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back. RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TALONS INTERLOCKED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1. RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EMPYRIC SEVERANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS CusTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EMPEROR'S EXECUTIONERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Adeptus Custodes units from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll. RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an Anathema Psykana unit and both are within 6" of each other.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TALONED PINCER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Adeptus Custodes units from your army that are within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your units can make a Normal move of up to 6". RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an Anathema Psykana unit and both are within 6" of each other.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Anathema Psykana Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one other friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6" of that ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOTIVE IMPERATIVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AUTO-DIVINATORY TARGETING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army, and one objective marker.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 3+ and the [IGNORES COVER] ability, but they can only target units within range of the selected objective marker.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MACHINE SPIRIT RESURGENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MACHINE SUPERIORITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TRANSCENDENT COGITATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BENEVOLENCE OF THE OMNISSIAH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, which is improved to Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INCANTATION OF THE IRON SOUL
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after you allocate a mortal wound to a CULT MECHANICUS model from your army.
profiles.target_descriptor: That CULT MECHANICUS model's unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CHANT OF THE REMORSELESS FIST
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VERSE OF VENGEANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TRIBUTE OF EMPHATIC VENERATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army and one enemy unit within 18" of it.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LITANY OF THE ELECTROMANCER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of one or more CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit, adding 1 to the result if that model is an ELECTRO-PRIEST. On a 5+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LUMINESCENT BLESSING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SERVO-DRIVEN CHARGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNRELENTING AGGRESSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the Skitarii keyword, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNSHACKLED WRATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Skitarii unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities to apply to those weapons until the end of the phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THREAT-COGITATION TARGETERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Skitarii Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRECISION ONSLAUGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a Sicarian unit from your army declares a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: That SICARIAN unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, when your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ANALYTIC REPRISALS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Skitarii Infantry unit from your army that lost one or more models as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CACHED ACQUISITION
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRIORITY RECLAMATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Consolidates.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within range of your Acquisition objective marker. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target a unit with this Stratagem if it is within 3" of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INFOSLAVE SKULL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TECH-PRIEST model from your army and one objective marker within 24" of that model (excluding your Acquisition objective marker].
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, that objective marker is also considered to be one of your Acquisition objective markers for all rules purposes.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AUTO-ORACULAR RETRIEVAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Acquisition objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INCENSE EXHAUSTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS SMOKE unit within 6" of it.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, both of those units have the Stealth ability and the Benefit of Cover.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REACTIVE SAFEGUARD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army within range of your Acquisition objective marker that was selected as a target of that charge, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TRANSPORT.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT. RESTRICTIONS: Every model in your unit must be within 3" of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ERADICATION PROTOCOLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, and, if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TARGETING OVERRIDE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NEURAL OVERLOAD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Select one Override ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active for your unit. Designer's Note: This means that if the targeted unit already has the HALO OVERRIDE keyword, it can be affected by multiple Override abilities at the same time, but suffers mortal wounds to do so. Alternatively, if your unit does not have the HALO OVERRIDE keyword, it instead has the chosen Override ability until the start of your next Command phase, but does not benefit from any other Override abilities that are active.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AGGRESSIVE IMPULSE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Skorpius Dunerider model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GUIDED RETREAT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army makes a Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and, if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, you can re-roll Desperate Escape tests taken for it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ANALYTICAL DIVINATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Mechanicus Infantry unit (excluding Kataphron units) from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BALEFUL HALO
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army (excluding Vehicle units) that was selected as the target of one or more of that enemy unit's attacks. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6" of it.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is made that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXTINCTION ORDER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tech-Priest model from your army and one objective marker within 24" of that model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within range of that objective marker. On a 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound and it must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AGGRESSOR IMPERATIVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6" of it.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRE-CALIBRATED PURGE SOLUTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6" of it.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of those units makes a ranged attack, if the target of that attack is within your opponent's deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LETHAL DOSAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BULWARK IMPERATIVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One SKITARII unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6" of it.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in those units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BIONIC ENDURANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase orthe Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One SICARIAN, PTERAXII or SYDONIAN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BINHARIC OFFENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Two SKITARII units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in both of your units by 1. RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target].
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXPEDITED PURGE PROTOCOL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One SKITARII unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ISOLATE AND DESTROY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One SICARIAN, PTERAXII, SYDONIAN, IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other enemy units within 6" of the unit targeted by that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHROUD PROTOCOLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One SKITARII INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROGRAMMED WITHDRAWAL
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two SICARIAN units from your army, or one SKITARII INFANTRY or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. RESTRICTIONS: Each unit targeted with this Stratagem must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: Layered Wards
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
profiles.target_descriptor: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: Soulsight
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit's attacks can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: Vectored Engines
