profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that was set upon the battlefield from Reserves this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OVERFLIGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Shooting phase or the end of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Asuryani Mounted unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 7".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WIND OF BLADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Asuryani Mounted or Vyper unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DARING RIDERS
profiles.when_descriptor: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army in Reserves.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield from Reserves, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. When doing so, if your unit is set up within 9" horizontally of one or more enemy units, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FOCUSED FIREPOWER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPIRALLING EVASION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ORDER THE ADVANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOBILE FIREBASE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BURST OF SPEED
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUPPORTING ORDNANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COMBINED FIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OPENING SALVO
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BELLICOSA DROP
profiles.when_descriptor: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that is in Reserves and has the Deep Strike ability.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, when your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FIRING HOT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Militarum Tempestus or Kasrkin unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, when targeting an enemy unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of hot-shot lascarbines, hot-shot lasguns, hot-shot laspistols, hot-shot marksman rifles, hot-shot volley guns and sentry hot-shot volley guns equipped by models in your unit by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FIRE AND RELOCATE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SERVO-DESIGNATORS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Astra Militarum Infantry unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks that is visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AERIAL EXTRACTION
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, if all of its models have the Deep Strike ability, or one Valkyrie unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ON MY POSITION
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Regiment Infantry unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COORDINATED ACTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REINFORCEMENTS!
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Infantry Regiment unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining. RESTRICTIONS: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FLEXIBLE COMMAND
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Any number of Astra Militarum Officer units from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to Regiment units and Squadron units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FIELDS OF FIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Regiment unit and one Squadron unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INSPIRED COMMAND
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STALWART PROTECTOR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SNAP TO IT
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit's OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NO RETREAT!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VETERAN SHARPSHOOTERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PURGING FIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MORDIAN MINUTE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army affected by the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! Order.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADDITIONAL ARMOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FINAL HOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Squadron unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding Officer units).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLAZING ADVANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Advances.
profiles.target_descriptor: That SQUADRON unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Squadron unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That SQUADRON unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CRASH THROUGH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FURIOUS CANNONADE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Squadron unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ABLATIVE PLATING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VOX-RELAY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Infantry Officer unit from your army embarked within a Transport. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it is embarked within a TRANSPORT.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can issue Orders even though it is not on the battlefield, and it can issue Orders to Astra Militarum Transport units from your army [excluding TiTANic units) regardless of the distance to and from your unit's TRANSPORT.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAPID DISPERSAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CLEAR AND SECURE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SWIFT INTERCEPTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Transport unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TiTANic units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 9" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HASTY EXTRACTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an AsTRA Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOVE OUT
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's turn.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an Astra Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CRACK SHOTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DRAW THEM OUT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Platoon unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SCRAMBLE FIELD
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Reinforcements step.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COURAGEOUS DIVERSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Infantry or Astra Militarum Mounted unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TANGLEFOOT GRENADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Grenades unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as the target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SCOUTING OUTRIDERS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's turn.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Mounted or Astra Militarum Walker unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TRENCH FIGHTERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a Regiment model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OVER THE TOP
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Infantry Officer model from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, when your model issues the Move! Move! Move! Order, it can issue that Order to any number of eligible friendly Infantry Regiment units, regardless of range to your model.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FLARE BURST
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit within 12", you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CALLOUS SACRIFICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Platoon unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model's unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FURIOUS FUSILLADE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Platoon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit while targeting an enemy unit within half range.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MINEFIELD
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Platoon unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENGINE OF WRATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2, and each time a model in your unit fights, it can only target that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IMPOSING ARRIVAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army that is in Reserves.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Set up your unit on the battlefield, wholly within 8" of the battlefield edge and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADAMANTINE BEHEMOTH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHATTERING SALVO
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum Titanic unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WITHERING FIREPOWER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ACCURACY UNDER PRESSURE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WRATH UNDENIABLE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GORE-HUNGRY ONSLAUGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SKULLS BEGET BLOOD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Khorne Infantry or Legiones Daemonica Khorne Mounted unit from your army (excluding units that Fell Back this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of one or more units from your army and is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLOOD BEGETS SKULLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit from your army that has not been selected to charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FOOLS' FLIGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One friendly unengaged LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a Fall Back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHEATHED IN BRASS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a Save characteristic of 3+.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THIEVES OF PAIN
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an attack or mortal wound is allocated to a model in a Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh unit from your army (excluding Monsters and Vehicles).
profiles.target_descriptor: That LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one other friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit that is within 9" of and visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, while the selected unit is on the battlefield, each time a model in your unit would lose a wound, inflict 1 mortal wound on the selected unit instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARCHAGONISTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh Monster unit or up to two Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh units (excluding Monsters) from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of those units makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SENSORY EXCRUCIATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh Monster unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each unit on the battlefield that is within your army's Shadow of Chaos must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Designer's Note: This Stratagem forces all friendly and enemy units alike within your army's Shadow of Chaos to take a Battle-shock test. This can allow a Chaos Daemons player to heal units from their army through the Daemonic Terror army rule, at the risk of causing some of their own units to become Battle-shocked.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PHANTASMAL LONGING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CAVALCADE OF BLADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, or roll six D6 instead if your unit is a MONSTER unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OVERWHELMING EXCESS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SEEPING VIRULENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FEVER VISIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. After your unit has finished making its attacks, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FOETID RESURGENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Return up to 1 destroyed model to your unit, or up to D3 destroyed models instead if your unit is a Battleline unit, with their full wounds remaining. If it is a Monster unit, one model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ROT AND RENEWAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MURKSHADOWS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal move, add 5" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PLAGUE OF WOES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Command phase, before selecting any targets for the Melancholic Miasma Detachment rule.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, after an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test as a result of the Melancholic Miasma Detachment rule, select one other enemy unit within 9" of your unit; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IMPOSSIBLE ECLIPSE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Tzeentch Monster unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select No Man's Land or your opponent's deployment zone, or spend one Flux token and select both. Until the end of the phase, the selected areas of the battlefield are within your army's Shadow of Chaos.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PYROGENESIS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Tzeentch unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight that phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in your unit, or spend one Flux token and add 3 to the Strength characteristic of those weapons and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1 instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FLICKERING REALITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Tzeentch unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6, then you can spend one Flux token to re-roll the result: until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, on an unmodified Hit roll (after any re-roll) of that result, the attack sequence ends, even if the original Hit roll would have been a Critical Hit. Example: If you roll a 2 and choose to spend one Flux token to re-roll the result, and the re-roll is a 6, then until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, on an unmodified Hit roll of 6 the attack sequence ends, that attack fails to hit and no Critical Hit effects (e.g. Lethal Hits) are resolved.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FATEBORNE NIGHTMARES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Tzeentch unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FICKLEFIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Tzeentch unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets for, and resolving attacks with, ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model is destroyed while its unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DELIRIUM UNMADE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Legiones Daemonica Tzeentch unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Alternatively, you can spend one Flux token when you use this Stratagem and target up to two LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH units from your army instead (including those within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPITEFUL DEMISE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a Shadow Legion unit from your army is destroyed, before removing the last model in that unit from the battlefield and before rolling any dice for the Deadly Demise ability.
profiles.target_descriptor: That SHADOW LEGION unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of the last model in your unit, adding 2 to the result if your unit has the Slaanesh keyword: on a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CHANNELLED WRATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Shadow Legion unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If your unit has the Khorne keyword, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEATH DENIED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Shadow Legion unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds. In addition, If your unit has the Tzeentch keyword, return up to one destroyed model (excluding Character models) to your unit with its full wounds remaining.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENCROACHING DARKNESS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to one Shadow Legion Heretic Astartes unit from your army and up to one Shadow Legion Legiones Daemonica unit from your army. You can only select units that arrived from Reserves this turn.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your selected units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHADE PATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One friendly SHADOW LEGION unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit. If your unit has the NURGLE keyword, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BINDING SHADOW
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to one Shadow Legion Heretic Astartes unit from your army and up to one Shadow Legion Legiones Daemonica unit from your army. You can only select units that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove those selected units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FERAL ARROGANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a Chaos Knights unit from your army.
profiles.target_descriptor: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MERCILESS FUSILLADE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army, and up to two friendly War Dog units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those CHAOS KNIGHTS units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BEASTHIDE MANIFESTATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FLUSH THE QUARRY
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army and up to three friendly War Dog units within 6" of that Titanic Chaos Knights unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CONTEMPTUOUS VOLLEYS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Chaos Knights unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GOADED BEAST
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: models in your unit move a number of inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VOX-HOWL
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One War Dog Character unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each friendly WAR DOG unit that is within 6" of your unit and is Battle-shocked must take a Leadership test; if that test is passed, that unit is no longer Battle-shocked. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HUNGRY FOR COMBAT
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Two or more War Dog units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those WAR DOG units. Until the end of the phase, models in those WAR DOG units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of those WAR DOG units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CUNNING HUNTER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a War Dog unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That WAR DOG unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ANIMALISTIC RAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a War Dog unit from your army that has not yet fought is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: That WAR DOG unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Before resolving your unit's Deadly Demise ability, it can either shoot or fight. When doing so, it must target only the enemy unit that just destroyed it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target. After it has done so and after any Consolidation moves have been made, resolve your unit's Deadly Demise ability as normal.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HARRYING HOUNDS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One War Dog unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENCIRCLING PACK
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One War Dog unit from your army that is wholly within 12" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AVENGE THE MASTERS!
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, the enemy unit that destroyed your unit is Marked. Each time a Damned model from your army makes an attack that targets a Marked unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WRETCHED MASSES
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Damned unit (excluding Accursed Cultists) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle. This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SOUL HUNGER
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army has fought.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Chaos Knights unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If one or more models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If one or more models from Battle-shocked units were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit regains up to D3+2 lost wounds instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNRESTRAINED RAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Chaos Knights unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WORTHLESS CHATTEL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Damned unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model's unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRESERVE THE IDOLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one Damned unit from your army that is not Battle-shocked, not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 6" of your unit. That DAMNED unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but it must end this move closer to that enemy unit than when it started the move.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROFANE SYMBIOSIS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is not Empowered.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HELLFORGED CONSTRUCTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CORRUPTING TAINT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.
profiles.target_descriptor: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNLEASH BALEFIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: After your unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test; if the test is failed, until the end of your opponent's next turn, it is aflame. While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WARP VISION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DIABOLIC BULWARK
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CLAIMED FOR THE DARK GODS
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPITEFUL DEMISE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit's Deadly Demise ability, that model's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RUNES OF DISDAIN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TITANIC DUEL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is TITANIC, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TROPHY HUNTER
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just before a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army consolidates.
profiles.target_descriptor: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CRUSHED LIKE VERMIN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army ends a Normal move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PTERRORSHADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CONQUERORS WITHOUT MERCY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After your model has finished making its attacks this phase, if it destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your model must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DISDAIN FOR THE WEAK

profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: A LONG LEASH

profiles.target_descriptor: One Abhorrent unit from your army and up to two friendly War Dog units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IMPERIOUS ADVANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two War Dog units from your army or one Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).

profiles.name: STORM OF DARKNESS

profiles.target_descriptor: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability, and each time an attack targets your unit, models in it have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability. In addition, if your unit is a Nurgle unit, it can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNFAILINGLY OBDURATE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SCOUR AND SEIZE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OPPORTUNISTIC RAIDERS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Fight phase
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", or up to 12" if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WARPCHARGED ENGINES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RUINOUS RAID
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REAVERS' HASTE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If you select one or more units within range of an objective marker as a target of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NEVER OUTGUNNED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VENGEFUL DESTRUCTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Heretic Astartes Infantry (excluding Damned units) or Heretic Astartes Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNDYING HATRED
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RENEGADE CLAIM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CORRUPTED MUNITIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REAVERS' REACTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DESPERATE PLEDGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GLUT OF SOULS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding Titanic units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wound).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAEMONIC POSSESION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding Daemon units).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNSTOPPABLE RAMPAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Heretic Astartes Vehicle or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes Normal, Advance or charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PREDATORY PURSUIT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FEEDING FRENZY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is within Engagement Range of your units Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, of that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, substract 1 from each of those tests.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENDLESS IRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units)
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponents Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BRINGERS OF DESPAIR
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLACK CRUSADE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LET THE GALAXY BURN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MILLENNIA OF EXPERIENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EMPYRIC DISLOCATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding Damned units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF CORRUPTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Heretic Astartes Terminator, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WARP FLICKER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
