profiles.target_descriptor: One Heretic Astartes Terminator, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WARP-TAINTED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Heretic Astartes Terminator, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SIEGEBREAKER STRIKE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PORTAL OF SPITE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if the closest eligible enemy unit is selected as one of the targets of that charge, add 2 to the Charge roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLESSINGS OF FILTH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MALIGNANCE MAGNIFIED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GROTESQUE FORTITUDE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RABID INFUSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard unit from your army that includes two Character models.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOBILE VECTOR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Character unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one other friendly Death Guard unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit's Starting Strength accordingly.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEATH'S HEADS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Biologus Putrifier unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle's Gift).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NAUSEATING PAROXYSMS
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VERMIN CLOUD
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EYE OF THE SWARM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DRONING HORROR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that attack targets a unit within half range, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENERVATING ONSLAUGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army makes a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Death Guard Infantry unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). Roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that unit, adding 1 to the result if that model is not a Cultist or Poxwalker model: for each 5+, the selected enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MYPHITIC INVIGORATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more friendly Myphitic Blight-hauler units and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of this unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GRIP OF THE WALKING POX
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SMEARED WITH FILTH
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GNAWING HUNGER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Poxwalkers unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HIDDEN AMONGST THE DEAD
profiles.when_descriptor: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHOCK AND HORROR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a Death Guard unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That DEATH GUARD unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHAMBLING WALL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly Poxwalkers unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PERSISTENT PESTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Nurglings unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CLUTCHING CORRUPTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more Plague Legions units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ALL IS ROT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model's unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FLESHY AVALANCHE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Plague Legions Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AVATARS OF DECAY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Plague Legions unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MIRESLICK
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PUTRID DETONATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Vehicle or Death Guard Monster model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PLAGUESURGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Your Death Guard WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LEECHSPORE ERUPTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard model your army that has lost one or more wounds.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OVERWHELMING GENEROSITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Character unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CREEPING BLIGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: POSTMORTALITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Haemonculus model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set the destroyed model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SYMPHONY OF SUFFERING
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after a Drukhari unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
profiles.target_descriptor: That DRUKHARI unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if your unit is a Haemonculus Covens unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: POISONER'S ART
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after a Haemonculus Covens unit from your army has fought.
profiles.target_descriptor: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit by one or more of your unit's attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DISTILLERS OF FEAR
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Haemonculus Covens unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Battle-shocked, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CONNOISSEURS OF PAIN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Drukhari unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Spend 1 Pain token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a Haemonculus Covens unit, you gain 1 Pain token.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENFOLDING NIGHTMARE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Haemonculus Covens unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6: your unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but it must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DOUBLE-CROSS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly Drukhari unit (excluding Vehicles).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit, if your DRUKHARI unit is within Engagement Range of the attacking model, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead, your DRUKHARI unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TAKEN ALIVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Drukhari unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your Contract unit is destroyed as a result of those attacks, every unit in your opponent's army must take a Battle-shock test. You cannot gain more than 3 Pain tokens as a result of failed Battle-shock tests caused by this Stratagem.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TAILORED TOXINS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets your Contract unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENEMIES WITHOUT NUMBER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase, just after you complete a Contract.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Archon WARLORD from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one new Contract (this can be one you have already completed), then select one unit from your opponent's army that is on the battlefield and matches the 'Contract' description in that Contract. Until that Contract is completed, that unit is your Contract unit and the Murderous Agenda Detachment rule applies as normal.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MAKING A POINT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kabalite Warriors or Hand of the Archon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEADLY DECEIVERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INSENSIBLE TO PAIN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Haemonculus Covens unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FIGHTING SHADOWS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Drukhari unit from your army (excluding Haemonculus Covens units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INSTINCTIVE SPITE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Drukhari Battleline units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: You can spend 1 Pain token. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in each of those units makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If you spent 1 Pain token, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DARK HARVEST
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Wracks units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in each of those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EAGER FOR THE KILL
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Wyches units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army, that have not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit (this is not cumulative with the Reavers' Matchless Swiftness ability).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAID AND FADE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Kabalite Warriors units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army (excluding ScouRGES and Aircraft).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6". RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Until the end of the turn, those units are not eligible to declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VICIOUS BLADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after a Drukhari Transport from your army has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: That TRANSPORT.
profiles.effect_descriptor: After your TRANSPORT has fought, select one enemy unit that was the target of one or more of those attacks and roll one D6 for each model embarked within your TRANSPORT, adding 1 to the result if that embarked model is a Wracks model: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WRAITHLIKE RETREAT
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Drukhari Infantry unit from your army that fought this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move, but unless it is a Wyches unit, it must end that move wholly within 3" horizontally and 5" vertically of a friendly Drukhari Transport and must embark within that TRANSPORT at the end of that move (otherwise, it cannot make that move).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: POUNCE ON THE PREY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari Infantry unit from your army disembarks from a Transport that made a Normal move this phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: That INFANTRY unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SKYBORNE ANNIHILATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Drukhari unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and that disembarked from a Transport this turn.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, or the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability if your unit is a Kabalite Warriors or Hand of the Archon unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SWOOPING MOCKERY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Drukhari Transport from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NIGHT SHIELD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Drukhari Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BERSERK FUGUE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Wych Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEADLY DEBUT
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Wyches unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FEIGNED WEAKNESS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That DRUKHARI unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRETERNATURAL AGILITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Movement or Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Wych Cult unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it and, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes such a move, it can move horizontally through models (when doing so, such a model can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end a Normal or Advance move within Engagement Range of them).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: A CHALLENGE MET
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that would be able to declare a charge if it were your Charge phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within 9" of your unit that was set up on the battlefield this phase or that ended a Normal or Advance move this phase. Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge. RESTRICTIONS: Even if that charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ACROBATIC DISPLAY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Wych Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUSTAINED BY AGONY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an Emperor's Children unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
profiles.target_descriptor: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one friendly Legions of Excess unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a Daemonettes unit, return upto D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ECSTATIC SLAUGHTER
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Legions OF Excess unit and one friendly Emperor's Children unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VIOLENT CRESCENDO
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Slaanesh Beasts, Slaanesh Infantry or SLAANESH Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SYCOPHANTIC SURGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more Emperor's Children units from your army.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNCANNY REACTIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Slaanesh unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DARK APPARITIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Daemonettes unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 9"), provided it is also set up wholly within 9" of one or more friendly Emperor's Children units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROTECTION OF THE DARK PRINCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an Emperor's Children unit from your army.
profiles.target_descriptor: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNSHAKEABLE OPPONENTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EMBRACE THE PAIN
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MARTIAL PERFECTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNBOUND ARROGANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor's Children unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
profiles.target_descriptor: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF ABHORRENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRIDEFUL SUPERIORITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SINUOUS BREACH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children Daemon unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS EXCRUCIATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model in your unit makes an attack that targets an eligible unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EUPHORIC INSPIRATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children Daemon unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly Emperor's Children units within 6" of your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CATALYTIC STIMULUS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Stimulus move. To do so, roll one D6: models in your unit move a number of inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VIOLENT EXCESS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COMBAT STIMMS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children iNFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HONOUR THE PRINCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DARK VIGOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army (excluding Beasts and Vehicles) that is within 9" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CAPRICIOUS REACTIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CRUEL RAIDERS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEFT PARRY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEATH ECSTASY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INCESSANT VIOLENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just before an Emperor's Children unit from your army Consolidates.
profiles.target_descriptor: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CRUEL BLADESMAN
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TERRIFYING SPECTACLE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CUT DOWN THE WEAK
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army (you can only select a Vehicle if it is a Walker) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ONTO THE NEXT
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADVANCE AND CLAIM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children Transport from your army that has one or more Tormentors units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DYNAMIC BREAKTHROUGH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CEASELESS ONSLAUGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport that made a Normal move this turn.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit is eligible to declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REACTIVE DISEMBARKATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children Transport from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One Emperor's Children unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OUTFLANKING STRIKE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Emperor's Children Transport from your army, or up to two Emperor's Children Dedicated Transports from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HONOUR IS FOR FOOLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Either player's turn; Fight phase
profiles.target_descriptor: One friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit that was selected to fight.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SINGLE-MINDED STRIKE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, when a FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit that is starting a Charge move.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move through models, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE models.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INTOXICATED BY TRIUMPH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit that was within Engagement Range of a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3 inches.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EVASIVE VANGUARD
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 9" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing those markers from the battlefield.
profiles.target_descriptor: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
profiles.effect_descriptor: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SAINTLY PAROXYSM
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Genestealer Cults Character model from your army.
profiles.target_descriptor: That destroyed CHARACTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If that Character model is an Abominant or Patriarch, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GENE-TWISTED MUSCLE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HYPER-METABOLIC VIGOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". In addition, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends it as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STIMULATED BIO-SURGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if the closest eligible enemy unit is selected as one of the targets of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll for each selected target of that charge (including the closest eligible enemy unit), to a maximum of +3.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BIO-HORROR REVELATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit within 9" of your unit is selected to shoot, it must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result. If that test is failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HYPERFEROCITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Genestealer Cults unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly Tyranids units are within 6" of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PSI SURGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit's Catalyst ability by 3". RESTRICTIONS: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AVENGE THE STAR CHILDREN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids Character unit from your army that was destroyed by that enemy unit this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, each time a Genestealer Cults model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DIVINE IMPERATIVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Genestealer Cults unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more Tyranids units from your army. Until the end of the phase, each time your GENESTEALER CULTS unit declares a charge, if that enemy unit is one of the targets of that charge, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit and you can re-roll the Charge roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DARTING ATTACKS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RESISTANCE TUNNELS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Genestealer Cults or Tyranids unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COORDINATED TRAP
profiles.when_descriptor: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRIMED AND READIED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TUNNEL CRAWLERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. RESTRICTIONS: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LYING IN WAIT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Genestealer Cults Battleline unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, when setting your unit up using a Cult Ambush marker, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Cult Ambush marker and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RETURN TO THE SHADOWS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: A DEADLY SNARE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ALONG SHADOWED TRAILS
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 9" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
profiles.target_descriptor: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
profiles.effect_descriptor: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEVOTED CREW
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Goliath Rockgrinder or Goliath Truck unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CLOSE-RANGE SHOOT-OUT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAPID FEINT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEFT MANOEUVRING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENCIRCLING THE PREY
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VENGEANCE FOR THE MARTYR!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Genestealer Cults Character model from your army.
profiles.target_descriptor: One other GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the destroyed model was a Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FRENZIED DEVOTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding Characters) in your unit by 1 and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TIRELESS FERVOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. When doing so, if it targets an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly Character units, you can re-roll the Charge roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TRANSCENDENT CELERITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE DOWNTRODDEN RISE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, you can set up your unit on the battlefield without using a Cult Ambush marker. When doing so, set up your unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE PATH OF ANGUISH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Acolyte Hybrids or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT), When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AGGRESSIVE ANTICIPATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: APPOINTED HOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FOREWARNED EVASION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Walker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NECESSARY END
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REDIRECTED STRIKE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves. Designer's Note: This Stratagem lets players utilise abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MIRAGE OF ECHOES
profiles.when_descriptor: The Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HEXWROUGHT REPRISAL
profiles.when_descriptor: End of any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WARDING CHANT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CHAOS BANE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CELERITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CIRCLE OF SANCTUARY
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Character model from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHADOW OF ANARCH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TRUESILVER CHANNELLING
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COMBAT MANIFESTATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PURGATION PATTERN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DUTY UNENDING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more Grey Knights units from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHINING VEIL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXPEDITIOUS EXIT
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Designer's Note: This Stratagem allows you to remove a unit in addition to those removed using the Gate of Infinity rule, and it allows you to remove a unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GIANTS OF THE BATTLEFIELD
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
