profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNENDING FIDELITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: POINT-BLANK PURGATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GRIND THEM UNDERFOOT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a Grey Knights Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That GREY KNIGHTS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRECOGNITIVE STRATEGIES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHINING RESOLVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TRUESILVER WILL
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a Grey Knights Psyker Vehicle unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
profiles.target_descriptor: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ABOMINUS-CLASS TARGETS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOURED AEGIS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Psyker Vehicle unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REDOUBLED ASSAULT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Grey Knights Vehicle unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FORCE WAVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARGENT WRATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a Grey Knights Vehicle unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SANCTIFIED KILL ZONE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a Purifier Squad.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FLAMES OF SANCTITY
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Purifier Squad unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes Castellan Crowe: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HALLOWED BEACON
profiles.when_descriptor: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit (excluding Terminator units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Set up your unit wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FIRES OF COVENANT
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AEGIS ETERNAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REPELLING SPHERE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army's Hallowed Ground.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VIOLENT ACQUISITION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LANCE] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MASTERS OF THE VOID
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One VOIDFARERS CHARACTER unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this turn can be set up within your opponent's deployment zone (all other restrictions still apply).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS BARRAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One VOIDFARERS unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EMPEROR'S WILL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DISPLACER FIELD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save and, after the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, unless your unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" (when doing so, models in this unit move as if they have the Fly keyword).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SELFLESS BODYGUARD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM Attached unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack with the [PRECISION] ability is allocated to a CHARACTER model in your unit, if there are one or more Bodyguard models in your unit, roll one D6: on a 2+, that attack is allocated to a Bodyguard model of your choice in your unit instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STUN GRENADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of any phase (excluding the Command phase).
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS GRENADES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS or VEHICLES) within 8" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DISPENSE JUSTICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INVIOLATE JURISDICTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRy unit from your army within range of an objective marker and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXECUTION ORDER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRy unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy CHARACTER unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit targets that CHARACTER unit, its weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LINE OF FIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can target enemy units that are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units with ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons), provided the target is within 12".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXACT PUNISHMENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM unit from your army is destroyed as the result of an enemy unit's attacks.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEpTUS ARbITES, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that was within 6" of the destroyed unit (you cannot target the destroyed unit with the Stratagem).
profiles.effect_descriptor: After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RITUAL OF WARDING
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of any Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO MAllEUS unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker is said to be Warded and remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. While an objective marker is Warded and under your control, enemy DAEMON units cannot be set up on the battlefield within 6" of it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RITES OF EXORCISM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAl AGENTS or ORDO MAllEUS unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy DAEMON unit within 12" and visible to your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, then until the end of the phase, each time a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMpERIUM unit makes an attack that targets that DAEMON unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STEEL HEART
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a GREy KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TRUESILVER ARMOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase orthe Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One GREy KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HEXAGRAMMIC WARDS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORDO MAllEUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, all Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PSYBOLT AMMUNITION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One GREy KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [PSYCHIC] abilities.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DEATHwATCH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DEATHwATCH unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the Furor Tactics, Malleus Tactics or Purgatus Tactics. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Deathwatch Mission Tactic is active for your unit instead of any other Deathwatch Mission Tactic that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Deathwatch Mission Tactic this battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DEATHwATCH INFANTRy unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons (excluding Devastating Wounds weapons) equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] abilities. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Dragonfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DEATHwATCH INFANTRy unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DEATHwATCH INFANTRy unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and improve the Range characteristic of those weapons by 6". RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Dragonfire Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAPID TACTICAL RELOCATION
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One INQUISITOR or DEATHwATCH INFANTRy unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRIME TARGET
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Agents of the Imperium unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that attack is made by an Officio Assassinorum model and it targets the enemy WARLORD, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HYPERSTIMMS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Agents of the Imperium Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit. In addition, if it is an Eversor Assassin unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WILL-SAPPING SALVO
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Agents of the Imperium Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, if it is a Culexus Assassin unit, until the end of the phase, change the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit to 3.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ORBITAL OVERSIGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Agents of the Imperium Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18", or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLIND GRENADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Agents of the Imperium Grenades or Vindicare Assassin unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit, or, if your unit is a VINDICARE ASSASSIN, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENSNARING TRAP
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Agents of the Imperium Infantry unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select one or more of those enemy units as the targets of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn. In addition, if it is a Callidus Assassin unit and it makes a Charge move as a result of this Stratagem, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NOBLE SACRIFICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+, adding 1 to the result if it is an Armiger unit, instead of only a 6.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STRENGTH FROM EXILE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 9" of your unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FULL TILT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, or 9" instead if your unit is an Armiger or Destrier unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: POINT-BLANK BARRAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, when making ranged attacks with Blast weapons, models in your unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of your unit (provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). In addition, until the end of the phase, your unit does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, but each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Blast weapon that targets a unit within Engagement Range of your unit, on an unmodified Hit roll of 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SURVIVOR OF STRIFE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FLANKING MANOEUVRES
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Armiger unit from your army that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DRIVE THEM OUT!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit on your defensive line, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LANCEBREAKER
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is on your defensive line.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greaterthan the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STEADFAST SUPERIORITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that is on your defensive line and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MARSHAL THE DEFENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Imperial Knights units from your army that have not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TITANIC BOMBARDMENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that Remained Stationary this turn, that is on your defensive line and that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FORTRESS OF INTIMIDATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that is on your defensive line.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OMNISSIAH'S GRACE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an Imperial Knights or Adeptus Mechanicus unit from your army.
profiles.target_descriptor: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VENGEANCE OF THE MACHINE CULT
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, the enemy unit that destroyed your unit is Marked. Each time an Adeptus Mechanicus model from your army makes an attack that targets a Marked unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BONDED IMPERATIVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase, just before an Imperial Knights Character unit from your army uses a Bondsman ability.
profiles.target_descriptor: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: When selecting targets for that use of that Bondsman ability, you can select one friendly Adeptus Mechanicus unit within 12" of your unit in addition, or instead of selecting one Armiger model. Until the start of your next Command phase, every model in that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is affected by that Bondsman ability. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target a Knight Preceptor with this Stratagem.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MACHINE FOCUS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any Hit roll or Wound roll made for it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AGGRESSION BEGETS AGGRESSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army or one Imperial Knights Character unit from your army and one friendly Adeptus Mechanicus unit that is within 6" of that unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [ASSAULT] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THRONEGHEIST FURY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that is within 24" of and visible to that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one ranged weapon equipped by a model in your unit. That model can shoot at that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, that model can only make attacks with that weapon and each time it makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon's Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COURAGEOUS STAND
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TITANIC DUEL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOMENT OF GLORY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just before an Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army Consolidates.
profiles.target_descriptor: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" provided your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HERO'S TREAD
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNSTOPPABLE WARRIOR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DRIVEN BY THE PAST
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VIRTUE OF COURAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXEMPLAR'S WISDOM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model, and one or more friendly Armiger models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MANTLE OF THE MENTOR
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your ARMIGER models are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THIN THEIR RANKS
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your ARMIGER models have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LET DUTY BE YOUR SHIELD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Armiger unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SQUIRES OFTHE HUNT
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model's Bondsman ability.
profiles.effect_descriptor: For each of your ARMIGER models that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove that ARMIGER model from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RUN THEM THROUGH!
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the [LANCE] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THUNDERSTOMP
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights model from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 8, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FULL TILT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of your models and add 2 to Advance rolls made for those model's units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VOW OF RETRIBUTION

profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TACTICAL FOIL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights model from your army that is within 9" of that unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your model can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ROTATE ION SHIELDS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SECURE POSITIONS

profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Transport unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your TRANSPORT. That unit cannot declare a charge in the same turn, but can otherwise act normally in the remainder of the turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BASTION RUNNING

profiles.target_descriptor: One Hekaton Land Fortress unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ILLUMINATED PRIORITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after a Leagues of Votann Vehicle unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a Leagues of Votann Infantry model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INEXORABLE EFFICIENCY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OPPORTUNISTIC ESCALATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, if units from your army have Hostile Acquisition.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Vehicle unit from your army (excluding Hekaton Land Fortress units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VENGEANCE FLARE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one friendly Kapricus or Sagitaur unit within 6" of your INFANTRY unit. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, you can select one friendly Hekaton Land Fortress unit within 6" of your INFANTRY unit instead. The selected unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. When doing so, models in the selected unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CYBERSTIMM INFUSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Cthonian Beserks unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNSTOPPABLE FORCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Piles In or Consolidates, each model in that unit can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AUGMENTED ASSAULT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Cthonian Beserks unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend up to 2YP. Until the end of the turn, add X" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, where X is the number of YP you spent during this use of this Stratagem, and your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TECTONIC FRACTURE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after a CTHONIAN EARTHSHAKERS unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Cthonian Earthshakers unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit's attacks this phase. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 2 from that unit's Move characteristic and, if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WEAVEWËRKE BUTTRESS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Hostile Acquisition.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HIDDEN ACCESSWAYS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Cthonian Beserks, Hearthkyn Warriors or Hernkyn Yaegirs unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BRËKKEKNOTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kâhl, Ûthar the Destined or Einhyr Hearthguard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SURE OF PURPOSE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUPERIOR CRAFTSMANSHIP
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNYIELDING AGGRESSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Leagues of Votann Infantry unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MATERIALISATION MATRICES
profiles.when_descriptor: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that is in Reserves and has the Deep Strike ability.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, when your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FURY OF THE HEARTH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Einhyr Hearthguard unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. If you spend 1YP, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNWAVERING ACCURACY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Brôkhyr Thunderkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll; that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FIRST CONCERN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after a Brôkhyr, Ironkin Steeljacks or Arkanyst Evaluator unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That BRÔKHYR, IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit Remained Stationary in your Movement phase this turn, it can make a Normal move.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DELAYED-FIRE ROUNDS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after a Brôkhyr, Ironkin Steeljacks or Arkanyst Evaluator unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That BRÔKHYR, IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time that enemy unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, roll one D6 for each model in that unit: for each 1, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WALL OF STEEL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after an Ironkin Steeljacks unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, rolling two additional D6 if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PREVENTATIVE PURGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Brôkhyr Thunderkyn or Ironkin Steeljacks unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. When doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COGITATED NEED
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Ironkin Steeljacks unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move. When doing so, your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AUXILIARY CONTRACT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Infantry or Leagues of Votann Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OPTIMAL EXPENDITURE
profiles.when_descriptor: The Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this usage of this Stratagem, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll the Wound roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GRAND ARTIFICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRIVATEER ARSENAL

profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. If you spent YP during this usage of this Stratagem, you can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll a Wound roll of 1 instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NEW HORIZONS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement range of one or more enemy units and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOBILE EXPLOITATION
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Hernkyn unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Alternatively, you can spend 2YP and target up to two HERNKYN units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units instead.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: VOID HARDENED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HONOUR OF THE HOLD
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ORDERED RETREAT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ANCESTRAL SENTENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HUNTR'S MARK
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REACTIVE REPRISAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, can only target that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADAPTABLE AVARICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of any phase, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Character unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend any number of YP. Once you have done so, if you have 6 or fewer YP, until the start of your next turn, units from your army have Hostile Acquisition instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FRONTIER MOMENTUM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXPOSED FLAWS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem and/or if that attack targets an assailed unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RANGER TACTICS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that attack targets an assailed unit and/or if your unit has the Hernkyn keyword, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CLAIMSTAKER REFLEX
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army (excluding Artillery and Vehicle units) that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead. RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot embark within a Transport as part of this move.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DISPERSED FORMATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Leagues of Votann Infantry or Leagues of Votann Mounted unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MASKS OF DEATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE SPOOR OF FRAILTY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your unit makes an attack that targets a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MURDEROUS REANIMATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit, or just caused an enemy unit that was not Below Half-strength to become Below Half-strength.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLOOD-FUELLED CRUELTY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INSANITY'S IRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed by the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Necrons Infantry Character model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining. RESTRICTIONS: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit].
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, If a Necrons Character is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration].
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, if a Necrons Character is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit from your army.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6" of that NECRONS unit when it was destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit's attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly CANOPTEK model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CYNOSURE OF ERADICATION
profiles.when_descriptor: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit from your army that is wholly within your army's Power Matrix.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SOLAR PULSE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CRYPTEK model from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one objective marker within 18" of your CRYPTEK model. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting units within range of that objective marker.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REACTIVE SUBROUTINES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUBOPTIMAL FACADE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge and is wholly within your army's Power Matrix.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOLECULAR TARGETING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the Cryptek keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Cryptek Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit has the Necron Warriors keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the Immortals keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ANIMUS CURSE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Cryptek model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit's attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SYNERGISTIC EMPOWERMENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Cryptek unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one friendly NECRONS model (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 12" of a CRYPTEK model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly NECRONS model has the CRYPTEK keyword.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNTAPPED POWER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Cryptek unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment Rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit's Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a Cryptek unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: METHODICAL MURDER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
