profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MORTIS PROTOCOLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a Destroyer Cult unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
profiles.target_descriptor: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 9" of that DESTROYER CULT unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: The friendly unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPREADING MADNESS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HYPERPHASIC RECALL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks and one friendly MONOLITH model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your INFANTRY unit from the battlefield and then set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of your MONOLITH model and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: QUANTUM DEFLECTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REANIMATION CRYPTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Your NECRONS WARLORD.
profiles.effect_descriptor: For each of your NECRONS units in Reserves, that Reserves unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COSMIC PRECISION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding Monster units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike or Hyperphasing abilities this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models. RESTRICTIONS: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DIMENSIONAL CORRIDOR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield this turn using the Eternity Gate ability of a MONOLITH model that started the turn on the battlefield.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit is eligible to charge this phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENTROPIC DAMPING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TITANIC model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 18" of the attacking unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: YOUR TIME IS NIGH
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after your opponent's WARLORD is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: Your NECRONS WARLORD.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENSLAVED ARTIFICE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NANOASSEMBLY PROTOCOLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SENTINELS OF ETERNITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUFFER NO RIVAL
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TERRITORIAL OBSESSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Lychguard or Triarch unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. If your unit has the VEHICLE keyword, add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DISHARMONISATION CASCADE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a Necrons Monster model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.
profiles.target_descriptor: That NECRONS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your model's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of on a 6.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOLECULAR EROSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Necrons Monster unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one unravelling enemy unit visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result. If that test is failed, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MASS TRANSMOGRIFICATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Necrons Monster unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
profiles.target_descriptor: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters) within 6" of that MONSTER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit's Reanimation Protocols activate. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENTROPHASIC AURA TARGETING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CHRONODISTORTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PHASE MELDING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MERCILESS RECLAMATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNYIELDING FORMS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CHRONOSHIFT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DIMENSIONAL TUNNEL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENDLESS SERVITUDE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REACTIVE REPOSITION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding Monster and Titanic units) that was the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOUNT UP, LADZ
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Orks Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your ORKS INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MEKANISED BRUTALITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Battlewagon, Kill Rig or Hunta Rig unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time a unit disembarks from your unit after your unit makes a Normal move, that disembarked unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RUN 'EM DOWN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Battlewagon, Kill Rig or Hunta Rig unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select up to two other friendly Orks Vehicle or Orks Monster units within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit and each unit you selected are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOURED DUELLISTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Orks Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IMPERVIOUS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Battlewagon, Kill Rig or Hunta Rig unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: YOOZ IN TROUBLE NOW
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Battlewagon, Hunta Rig or Kill Rig model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One Orks Infantry unit embarked within your model can disembark and make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: models in that unit move a number of inches up to this result, but that unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMED TO DATEEF
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TOO ARROGANT TO DIE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if a Waaagh! is active for your unit. On a 5+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ALWAYS LOOKIN' FER A FIGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army that destroyed that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3". If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, it can move up to 6" instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 4+ instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CUT'EM DOWN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if a Waaagh! is active for your unit, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HULKING BRUTES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DRAG IT DOWN
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Beast Snagga unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets your Prey, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Beast Snagga unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). If that enemy unit is your Prey, roll three additional D6.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAT ONE'S EVEN BIGGA!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Beast Snagga unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. In addition, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for your unit, provided one of the targets of that charge is your Prey.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WHERE D'YA FINK YOU'RE GOING?
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Beast Snagga Infantry or Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STALKIN' TAKTIKS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Beast Snagga Infantry or Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack. In addition, if your unit has the INFANTRY keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Beast Snagga unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: KLANKIN' KLAWS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Orks Walker unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit and, if you chose to push it, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons and they have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUPERFUELLED BOILER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an Orks Walker unit from your army has been selected to Advance.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Orks Walker unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BIGGER SHELLS FOR BIGGER GITZ
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Mek, Orks Walker or Grots Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll. If you chose to push it, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAKKA! DAKKA! DAKKA!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Orks Walker or Grots Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If you chose to push it, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CONNIVING RUNTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Gretchin unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXTRA GUBBINZ
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Orks Walker or Grots Vehicle unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BASH AND GRAB
profiles.when_descriptor: The Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of the loot objective, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GRAB AND BASH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding Gretchin units) that is within range of the loot objective.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your unit, even if you have already called a Waaagh! this battle. Designer's Note: This means that any abilities that are in effect while the Waaagh! is active for your army will be in effect for your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BOARDIN' RUSH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DECK FRAGGERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit targets an INFANTRY unit with a ranged weapon, that weapon has the [BLAST] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ROLLING LOOT-HEAP
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Flash Gitz unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: KRUMP AND RUN
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit falls back.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that was within engagement range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase and is not within range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COMPETITIVE STREAK
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Boyz unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit contains 10 or more models, re-roll the Wound roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BULLDOZER BRUTALITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Boyz unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in your unit are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BRAGGIN' RIGHTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Two Boyz units from your army that are within 6" of each other.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, while those two units are within 6" of each other, they both count as containing 10 or more models for the purposes of your Detachment rule, any Enhancements models from your army have and any Stratagems you use.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COME ON LADZ!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Boyz unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Return up to D3+2 destroyed models to your unit (excluding Character models).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TIDE OF MUSCLE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Boyz unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, add 1 to the Charge roll and, if your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the Charge roll.'
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GO GET 'EM!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Boyz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can make a Go Get 'Em! move. To do so, roll one D6: each model in your unit can move a distance in inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. If your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit can move.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit is a VEHICLE unit with an unmodified Toughness characteristic of 8 or less, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SQUIG FLINGIN'
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Speed Freeks or Trukk unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, when doing so, subtract 1 from the result.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAKKASTORM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Speed Freeks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. While targeting a unit within 9", they have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead. RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Blitza Fire Stratagem in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLITZA FIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Speed Freeks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability and, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 9", a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6. RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Dakkastorm Stratagem in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FULL THROTTLE!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Speed Freeks unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MORE GITZ OVER 'ERE!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Speed Freeks unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ORKS IS STILL ORKS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that enemy unit is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GET STUCK IN, LADZ!
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding Gretchin units).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your unit, even if you have already called a Waaagh! this battle. Designer's Note: This means that any abilities that are in effect while the Waaagh! is active for your army will be in effect for your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HUGE SHOW-OFFS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Orks Walker unit (excluding Killa Kans) from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, improve your unit's Move, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics by 1, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPESHUL SHELLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target within 18", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CALL DAT DAKKA?
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ON DA MOVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back or Advanced (unless it used its turbo this turn).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOBILE DAKKASTORM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after a Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: That SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding attacks made with Indirect Fire weapons). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPESHUL AMMO
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding Torrent weapons) have the [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] abilities.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DED KILLY CONSTRUCTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability and, if your unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DUST TRAILS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Benefit of Cover.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EVASIVE MANOOVA
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAT'S OURS
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FIGHT PROPPA
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Orks Infantry or Orks Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TAKTIKAL RETREAT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ORKS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: KRUNCHIN' DESCENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a STORMBOYZ unit from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Stormboyz unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ON TO DA NEXT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DED SNEAKY
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kommandos or Stormboyz unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CAREEN!
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an Orks Vehicle unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: That destroyed ORKS VEHICLE unit, if you roll a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move over enemy units (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) as if they were not there.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNBRIDLED CARNAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: 'ARD AS NAILS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding Grots, Monster and Vehicle units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MOB RULE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Mob unit from your army that contains 10 or more models and is not Below Half-strength.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one friendly Battle-shocked Orks Infantry unit within 6" of that MOB unit. That ORKS INFANTRY unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ERE WE GO
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Orks Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HEROES OF THE CHAPTER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TERRIFYING PROFICIENCY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: In your opponent's next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DUTY AND HONOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ORBITAL TELEPORTARIUM
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LEGENDARY FORTITUDE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RIGID DISCIPLINE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can immediately make a Fall Back move of up to 6". RESTRICTIONS: When making that move, your unit must end that move either wholly within your deployment zone or within range of an objective marker.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NOT ONE BACKWARDS STEP
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army within range of an objective marker.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, double the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit, but it must Remain Stationary this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NO THREAT TOO GREAT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BATTLE DRILL RECALL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If your unit Remained Stationary this turn, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MACHINE WRATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a Heavy Transport unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: That HEAVY TRANSPORT unit, if you rolled a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) and can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAPID EMBARKATION
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and one friendly Heavy Transport it is able to embark within.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that HEAVY TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CERAMITE SLEDGEHAMMER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features. In addition, if your unit is a Heavy Transport, when making this move, your unit can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) and can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADVANCED DEPLOYMENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, units can disembark from your TRANSPORT after it has Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move this phase, and cannot declare a charge in the same turn (unless your TRANSPORT has the Assault Ramp ability), but can otherwise act normally.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PURGATION DOCTRINE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll (if your unit disembarked from a Heavy Transport this turn, add 1 to the Wound roll as well).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CODEX DISCIPLINE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that target is auspex scanned, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GUIDED DISRUPTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army has finished making its attacks.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: When an enemy unit is auspex scanned as a result of those attacks this turn, if that enemy unit does not have the MONSTER or VEHICLE keywords, until the start of your next turn, it is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit's Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: LIGHT OF VENGEANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability while targeting an auspex scanned unit or if the bearer has the Battleline keyword.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SHOCK BOMBARDMENT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army finished making its attacks.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: When an enemy unit is auspex scanned as a result of those attacks this turn, until the start of your next turn, it is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HERESY UNDONE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Battleline units) from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. If it does, every target of that charge and every target of those attacks must be an auspex scanned unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!

profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the Devastator Doctrine, Tactical Doctrine or Assault Doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for your unit instead of any other Combat Doctrine that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Combat Doctrine this battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 9" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is under the effects of the Tactical Doctrine.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNYIELDING MIGHT

profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristics of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STAND TO THE END

That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AUGMENTED TARGETING

profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select either the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. If your unit is ENTRENCHED, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities instead.

profiles.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest eligible target within 6", add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAPID EMBARKATION

profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit from your army that has no models embarked within it, and one ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your INFANTRY unit can embark within that TRANSPORT. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target an INFANTRY unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that cannot normally embark within that TRANSPORT, or that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

profiles.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, Torrent weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ONSLAUGHT OF FIRE

profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target within 12", add 1 to the Hit roll. profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

profiles.name: HONOUR THE CHAPTER
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the Devastator Doctrine, Tactical Doctrine or Assault Doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for that unit instead of any other Combat Doctrine that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that doctrine this battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STORM OF FIRE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SQUAD TACTICS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is within 9" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is under the effects of the Tactical Doctrine. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RUTHLESS BUTCHERY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DOMINATOR BEACON
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COGITATED FEROCITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select either the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AUGMETIC FORTITUDE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DROPSHIP EXTRACTION
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TARGET WEAK POINT

profiles.target_descriptor: One Tank Ace unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted with this and the Kill Shot Stratagem in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: KILL SHOT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tank Ace unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If the target unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead. RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted with this and the Target Weak Point Stratagem in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAPID GUNNERY

profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REACTIVE REPOSITIONING
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tank Ace unit from your army (excluding units containing one or more models with a Wounds characteristic of 16+) that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MACHINE VENGEANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tank Ace unit from your army (excluding units containing one or more models with a Wounds characteristic of 16+) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is visible and an eligible target.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase
excluded_keywords: MORE WITH A WOUNDS CHARACTERISTIC OF 16

profiles.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION

profiles.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ANCIENT FURY

profiles.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT

profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit that is within 18" of and visible to one PSYKER model in your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit's Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. In addition, if the Telepathy Discipline is active for your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
