profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll, and if the Pyromancy Discipline is active for your army, weapons that target your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IRON ARM

profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, or add 2 if the Biomancy Discipline is active for your army.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ASSAIL

profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Psyker unit from your army that is eligible to shoot.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to one or more PSYKER models in your unit (excluding units with the Lone Operative ability), and roll six D6, adding 1 to each result if the Telekinesis Discipline is active for your army: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRESCIENT PRECISION

profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and the [IGNORES COVER] ability as well if the Divination Discipline is active for your army.

profiles.name: SUPPRESSION STRAFING

profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit visible to and within 18" of your unit. That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from that test and, if that test is failed, until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TACTICAL DECAPITATION

profiles.name: SHOCK ONSLAUGHT

profiles.name: BLIND SCREEN

profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ONWARD FOR THE EMPEROR

profiles.name: CRUSADING CONQUERORS

profiles.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6". RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: A DEADLY PRIZE
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker is said to be Sabotaged, and remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. While an objective marker is Sabotaged and under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SURGICAL STRIKES
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit that is more than 12" away, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CALCULATED FEINT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a PHOBOS or ScouT SQUAD unit. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GUERRILLA TACTICS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two PHOBOS and/or SCOUT SQUAD units from your army, or one other ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. RESTRICTIONS: Each unit selected for this Stratagem must be more than 3" away from all enemy models.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AUTOMATED REPAIR DRONES
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one BATTLESUIT model in your unit: that model regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REACTIVE IMPACT DAMPENERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXPERIMENTAL WEAPONRY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time you roll one or more dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in your unit, you can re-roll the result.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EXPERIMENTAL AMMUNITION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one of the following to apply to your unit until the end of the phase: - Improve the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. - Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1, and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Experimental Ammunition and Threat Assessment Analyser Stratagems in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THREAT ASSESSMENT ANALYSER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities to apply to those weapons until the end of the phase. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Experimental Ammunition and Threat Assessment Analyser Stratagems in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: NEUROWEB SYSTEM JAMMER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Crisis unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: A TEMPTING TRAP
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. The first time you use this Stratagem, you must also select one objective marker that is not in your opponent's deployment zone; until the end of the battle, this becomes your Trap objective marker.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Trap objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: POINT-BLANK AMBUSH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COORDINATE TO ENGAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has just been selected as an Observer unit (see For the Greater Good).
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets their Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if your unit has the Markerlight keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: COMBAT EMBARKATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Infantry unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge, and one friendly Transport.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT. If it does, your opponent can select new targets for that charge. RESTRICTIONS: Every model in your T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit must be within 3" of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PHOTON GRENADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Grenades unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test, and until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WALL OF MIRRORS
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Stealth, Ghostkeel or Commander Shadowsun unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: JOIN THE HUNT
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kroot Infantry or Kroot Hounds unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength. RESTRICTIONS: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed Character units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: A TRAP WELL LAID
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kroot unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: After your unit has resolved its attacks this phase, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, unless the attacking unit is Battle-shocked, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EMP GRENADES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot or fight.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kroot Grenades unit from your army within 8" of that enemy VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, worsen the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of that enemy VEHICLE unit's weapons by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE GRISLY FEAST
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kroot unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: In your opponent's next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GUERRILLA WARRIORS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Kroot unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That KROOT unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HIDDEN HUNTERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Kroot unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FAIL-SAFE DETONATOR
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a T'au Empire Battlesuit model from your army is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: That destroyed model's unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even if that unit was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Before removing your model from play, if it has the Deadly Demise ability, do not roll for that ability; instead, you can choose whether the result of that roll is a 1 or a 6. If your model does not have the Deadly Demise ability, roll one D6 for each unit within 6" of it: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STIMM INJECTORS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE SHORTENED BLADE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models. RESTRICTIONS: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE ARRO'KON PROTOCOL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that contains 6 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If that attack targets an enemy unit that contains 11 or more models, it has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE TORCHSTAR GAMBIT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that can FLY whose attacks have been resolved this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. If it does, your unit cannot declare a charge this turn
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GRAV-INHIBITOR FIELD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One T'au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test and you must roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 6, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SULPHUROUS VEIL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons or Scintillating Legions unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DECEPTIVE GLAMOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets for its attacks, it can only target your unit if there are no eligible Scintillating Legions targets for those attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ETHEREAL PHANTASM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Scintillating Legions unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is wholly within 6" of one or more friendly Thousand Sons units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FRACTAL DISJUNCTION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Scintillating Legions unit from your army (excluding Monsters) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CHRONOSORCEROUS BLEED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker or Scintillating Legions unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GLIMMERSHIFT PORTAL
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Scintillating Legions units from your army (excluding Monsters), or one Scintillating Legions Monster unit from your army, if all of those units are more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PSYCHIC DOMINION
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [hazardous] ability, and models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DESTINED BY FATE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after a saving throw is failed for a Thousand Sons Psyker model from your army. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple saving throws at once.
profiles.target_descriptor: That PSYKER model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those attacks you failed a saving throw for.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: EGOTISTICAL POWER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability applies to your unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DESECRATION OF WORLDS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARCANE FOCUS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase, just after you take a Psychic test for a Thousand Sons model from your army that Channelled the Warp (before resolving that Ritual).
profiles.target_descriptor: That THOUSAND SONS model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that Psychic test (including the additional D6 for Channelling the Warp).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEVASTATING SORCERY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 9" to the Range characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WARDING HEX
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control, if that objective marker is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WRATH OF THE DOOMED
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: STRANDS OF TIME
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Thousand Sons Psyker unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic when it is targeted with this Stratagem, then until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THROUGH THE VEIL
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Rubric Marines or Scarab Occult Terminators unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If it is a RUBRIC MARINES unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Deep Strike ability. When your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATOR unit it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models. RESTRICTIONS: If a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit is targeted with this Stratagem, it is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SCOURING WARPFLAME
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. After your unit has shot this phase, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: KALEIDOSCOPIC TEMPEST
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and, if your unit is wholly within your army's Flow of Magic, each time an attack targets your unit, it has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ARDENT AUTOMATA
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Rubricae unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That RUBRICAE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INEXORABLE ADVANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Rubricae unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance rolls made for it, and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INFERNAL FUSILLADE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, all inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi-bolters and inferno combi-weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and a Strength characteristic of 5.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REVENGE OF THE RUBRICAE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after a Thousand Sons Psyker model from your army is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Rubricae unit from your army that was within 6" of that PSYKER model when it was destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: After the attacking unit has shot, your RUBRICAE unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target the enemy unit that just destroyed your PSYKER model (and only if it is an eligible target).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IMPLACABLE GUARDIANS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Rubric Marines Psyker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit (excluding PSYKER models), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNWAVERING PHALANX
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Rubric Marines unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HEX-MARKED ARMOUR
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MUTATE LANDSCAPE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker is mutated, and remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. While an objective marker is mutated and under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CYBERSPIRIT MACHINATIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a Thousand Sons Vehicle unit from your army Falls Back.
profiles.target_descriptor: That VEHICLE unit, and one friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit within 6" of that VEHICLE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your VEHICLE unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MALEVOLENT ANIMUS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Vehicle unit from your army within 6" of one or more friendly Thousand Sons Psyker units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, your VEHICLE unit is malevolent. While a unit is malevolent, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the profile characteristics of its models; the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENSORCELLED INFUSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, that is within 6" of one or more friendly Thousand Sons Psyker units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by VEHICLE models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and each time an attack is made with such a weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WARPFLAME GARGOYLES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Vehicle unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll six D6: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. That enemy unit must then take a Battle-shock test.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: GIFT OF CHANGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Character model from your army (excluding Monsters) that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: At the end of the phase, add one Tzeentch Chaos Spawn unit containing one model to your army, and set it up as close as possible to where your model was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: WARPED VICISSITUDE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tzaangors unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DERANGED FEROCITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after a Tzeentch Mutant unit from your army is selected to fight.
profiles.target_descriptor: That TZEENTCH MUTANT unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", and when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in it that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLESSED TRANSMUTATIONS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Thousand Sons Psyker model from your army, and one friendly Tzaangors unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 12" of that PSYKER model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Return up to D3+1 destroyed models (excluding Characters) to your TZAANGORS unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TOUCHED BY TZEENTCH
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tzeentch Mutant unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TWISTED MIRAGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tzeentch Mutant unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, or anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units if it is a Monster unit. In either case, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BROODGUARD IMPULSE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Harvester unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RECLAIM BIOMASS
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model in it is removed from play.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Harvester unit from your army that is within 6" of that destroyed unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (See Feed the Swarm).
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TYRANNOFORMED
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Harvester unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ABLATIVE CARAPACE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Harvester unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, until the end of the phase models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SECURE BIOMASS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Harvester unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAPACIOUS HUNGER
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit immediately Regenerates (See Feed the Swarm). When doing so, if your unit is a Harvester unit and you choose for one model to regain up to D3 lost wounds, that model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: CORROSIVE VISCERA
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Tyranids Monster model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that cannot FLY is destroyed.
profiles.target_descriptor: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAMPAGING MONSTROSITIES
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SAVAGE ROAR
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that Battle-shock test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNTRAMMELLED FEROCITY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so: - It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them. - It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SWARM-GUIDED SALVOES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that model's Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MASSIVE IMPACT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase, just after a Tyranids Monster model from your army ends a Charge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your model and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RAPID REGENERATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADRENAL SURGE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army and are eligible to fight, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army that is eligible to fight.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in any of those selected units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DEATH FRENZY
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OVERRUN
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.
profiles.target_descriptor: That TYRANIDS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, instead of making that Consolidation move, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PREDATORY IMPERATIVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one Hyper-adaptation. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hyper-adaptation is active for those selected units in addition to any other that may be active for your army. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same Hyper-adaptation you selected at the start of the first battle round.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENDLESS SWARM
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Endless Multitude units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each of the selected units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ADAPTIVE OPTIMISATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Mawloc or Trygon unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the Synapse keyword.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REPLENISHING SWARMS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids unit from your army, wholly within 9" of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you can return up to D3+1 destroyed models with a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit, with their full wounds remaining, instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENFILADING EMERGENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TUNNEL NETWORK
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again, wholly within 9" of another Tunnel Marker you placed, and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SWARMING ASSAULT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Charge phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, friendly Tyranids units within 6" of your unit can re-roll Charge rolls.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RETREAT BELOW
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranids unit or up to two Burrower units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: THE SMOTHERING SHADOW
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Synapse unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SYNAPTIC CHANNELLING
profiles.when_descriptor: Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Synapse unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, while a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the selected unit, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IRRESISTIBLE WILL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Synapse unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model's unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: REINFORCED HIVE NODE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Synapse unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IMPERATIVE DOMINANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one Synaptic Imperative, even if you have already selected that imperative this battle. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your unit instead of any other Synaptic Imperative that is active for your army.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: OVERRIDE INSTINCTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and made a Fall Back move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SYNAPTIC GOADING
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, just before an Endless Multitude unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a Surge move.
profiles.target_descriptor: That ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: When making that Surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit]. All other rules for making Surge moves still apply.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNENDING WAVES
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength. RESTRICTIONS: Any destroyed Character units that were attached to your unit are not returned. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: TEEMING MASSES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SWARMING MASSES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and If your unit contains 15 or more models, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BOUNDING ADVANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Endless Multitude unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PRESERVATION IMPERATIVE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SURPRISE ASSAULT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Vanguard Invader unit from your army has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: That VANGUARD INVADER unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one enemy unit that was selected as the target of one or more of your unit's attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the Battle-shock test was failed, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ASSASSIN BEASTS
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Vanguard Invader Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SEEDED BROODS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves, or up to two Vanguard Invader units from your army that are in Reserves.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up those selected units on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HYPERSENSORY SCILLIA
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Vanguard Invader units from your army that are within 9" of that enemy unit, or one other Tyranids Infantry unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Those selected units can each make a Normal move of up to 6". RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNSEEN LURKERS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Vanguard Invader unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6". Your opponent can select new targets for the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: INVISIBLE HUNTER
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: Up to two Vanguard Invader units from your army, or one Tyranids Infantry unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. RESTRICTIONS: The targeted units must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SYNAPTIC AMPLIFICATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If that unit is a Tyranid Warriors unit, select up to one Endless Multitude unit from your army, that is not Battle-shocked, within 6" of it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in those units makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, and, if it is a TYRANID WARRIORS unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 as well.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SPONTANEOUS HYPERCORROSION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit and add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by Tyranid Warriors and Winged Tyranid Prime models in your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: RESTORATIVE IMPULSE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranid Warriors unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Return 1 destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to your unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SYNAPTIC MICRONODES
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranid Warriors unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: PARASITIC PAYLOAD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Shooting phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranid Warriors with Ranged Bio-weapons unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. After your unit has resolved its shooting attacks this phase, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SYNAPTIC SHIELD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Tyranid Warriors unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If that unit is a TYRANID WARRIORS unit, select up to one Endless Multitude unit from your army, that is not Battle-shocked, within 6" of it. Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack targets one of those units, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLOOD OFFERING
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: HACK AND SLASH
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and that made a charge move this turn.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FRENZIED RESILIENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SKULLS FOR THE SKULL THRONE!
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER or MONSTER model.
profiles.target_descriptor: That World Eaters unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Make a Blessings of Khorne roll and use the results to activate one Blessing of Khorne. Until the end of the battle round, that Blessing of Khorne is active in addition to any other Blessings of Khorne that are currently active.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: APOPLECTIC FRENZY
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase, just after a KHORNE BERZERKERS unit from your army is selected to Advance.
profiles.target_descriptor: That Khorne Berzerkers unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BERZERKER'S WRATH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Khorne Berzerkers unit from your army that can make a Blood Surge move as a result of those attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Do not roll a D6 to determine how far models in your unit can move when they make their Blood Surge move. Instead, when making their Blood Surge move, these models can move up to 8".
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLOODY VENGEANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Monster or World Eaters Titanic unit from your army that was just destroyed by an enemy unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in a Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DRAWN TO THE SLAUGHTER
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Jakhals unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength. RESTRICTIONS: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed Character units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: IN THE SHADOW OF BRASS IDOLS
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within 6" of one or more friendly World Eaters Monster units, or within 9" of one or more friendly World Eaters Titanic units, your unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLOODTHIRSTY HORDE
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FAIL NOT THE BLOOD GOD
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that model's unit is within 6" of one or more friendly World Eaters Monster units, or within 9" of one or more friendly World Eaters Titanic units, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BRAZEN IDOL
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Monster or World Eaters Titanic unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select the Idol of Infinite Rage, Idol of Burning Wrath or Idol of Blessed Blood. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Idols of Khorne ability is active for your unit instead of any other Idols of Khorne ability that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that ability this battle. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: ENDLESS PURSUIT OF VIOLENCE
profiles.when_descriptor: End of the Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Infantry unit from your army and one friendly Transport that it is able to embark within.
profiles.effect_descriptor: If your WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SMASH THROUGH
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Vehicle model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Rhino model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One WORLD EATERS unit embarked within your RHINO can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your RHINO and can be set up within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FULL-THROTTLE ASSAULT
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Movement phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Rhino model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time a WORLD EATERS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: UNRELENTING ADVANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Vehicle model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Your model can make a Normal move of up to 6". RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Fury Unleashed Stratagem in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: FURY UNLEASHED
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Rhino model from your army that has one or more wounds remaining and was hit by one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: One Khorne Berzerkers unit embarked within your model can disembark and make a Blood Surge move. RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Unrelenting Advance Stratagem in the same phase.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: SUMMONED BY SLAUGHTER
profiles.when_descriptor: Any phase, when the last model in a unit is destroyed, before removing it from play. (If that unit is a Transport, any units embarked within that TRANSPORT model must disembark first.)
profiles.target_descriptor: One Bloodletters unit from your army that is in Reserves.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 9" of that destroyed model and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, then remove the destroyed model from play. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAEMONIC FURY
profiles.when_descriptor: Start of your Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Blood Legions unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one friendly World Eaters unit within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in your WORLD EATERS unit have the [LANCE] ability. If the Daemonic Rage ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase those melee weapons also have the [TWIN-LINKED] ability.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: A WORTHY SKULL
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase, just after a Blood Legions or World Eaters unit from your army has fought, and one or more enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks.
profiles.target_descriptor: That BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit.
profiles.effect_descriptor: You gain D3BTP and you can then spend one or more BTP you have to activate one of the Blood Tithe abilities.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: BLESSING OF BURNING BLOOD
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Blood Legions unit from your army that is within 6" of a friendly World Eaters unit that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If the Boon of Blood ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAEMONTIDE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your Command phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters unit from your army.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Select one friendly Blood Legions unit within 6" of your unit. One destroyed Mounted model, up to D3 destroyed Beast models, or up to D6 destroyed Infantry models are returned to that BLOOD LEGIONS unit with their full wounds remaining. RESTRICTIONS: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed Character models to Attached units.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: MURDER-CALL
profiles.when_descriptor: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
profiles.target_descriptor: One Blood Legions unit from your army that is on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAEMONIC RESISTANCE
profiles.when_descriptor: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
profiles.target_descriptor: One World Eaters Possessed unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
profiles.effect_descriptor: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
profiles.restrictions_descriptor: matched play same stratagem per phase

profiles.name: DAEMONIC STRENGTH
profiles.when_descriptor: Fight phase.
